## Background
<!-- What were you doing? Which part (ears / core / CI / deploy)? Which session (web / pycharm)? -->

<!-- Exact error text or observed behaviour. No tokens, .env contents, or personal data. -->

<!-- Why it happened, with file:line where possible. "Unknown yet" is fine. -->

<!-- What was changed (PR/commit), or the proposed fix. -->

## Watch for
<!-- What future work should keep in mind so this doesn't come back. -->
